verdict: No paid activity this period; organic presence is your only active signal.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, so all measurable activity came from your Google Business Profile. That profile generated 42 actions — 2 calls, 31 direction requests, and 9 website clicks — across 24 active days, but engagement dropped sharply in the most recent 7 days, down 87% versus the 7 days before, with the last 3 days showing zero actions. Of 328 profile impressions this period, only 2 resulted in a call, which points to the profile itself needing strengthening to convert more viewers into contacts. Website conversion tracking is also not firing correctly, so the 191 sessions recorded this period are likely under-reporting actual contact activity — that repair is underway.
